helpText: Your next opportunity starts with a better understanding.
notificationText: 12 new mock opportunities are ready for review. No live sources are connected.
subtitle: Discover opportunities. Understand requirements. Make informed decisions.
latestSub: AI-screened projects with potential for Oceanpower
potential: Potential supplier · not a confirmed bidder
aiTitle: An opportunity worth a closer look
aiDescription: Coastal and underground projects show strong alignment with Oceanpower’s corrosion-resistant FRP portfolio.
workflowSub: A five-stage workflow, with your team in control.
disclaimer: AI provides recommendations. Final engineering, pricing and commercial decisions require human approval.
demoNote: Prototype · All projects, metrics and competitor updates are illustrative mock data.
summaryBody: This project may require durable, corrosion-resistant reinforcement. Oceanpower FRP products may be suitable, subject to technical qualification and engineering review.
req2: Long-term durability and verified structural performance
req3: Engineering standards and design acceptance to be confirmed
missingBody: Reinforcement quantities, approved material grades, fire-performance requirements and procurement eligibility are not confirmed.
whyBody: The application aligns with Oceanpower’s FRP reinforcement portfolio. Relevance indicates a potential fit, not confirmed compliance or a bid recommendation.
nextActionBody: Ask the buyer to confirm material acceptance, quantities and tender eligibility. Assign an engineer to validate the proposed product before bidding.
standardsBody: Project-specific design codes and material testing standards require confirmation from the buyer.
documentsBody: This prototype uses structured mock records. Original tender documents will appear here when approved data sources are connected.
sourceNote: Source category only. This is a fictional tender, not a verified announcement.
reportSubtitle: Turn market signals into a focused briefing for your team.
executiveBody: The illustrative China market snapshot includes 128 new opportunities: 36 high-relevance and 52 medium-relevance projects, plus 40 competitor updates. The detailed register below contains 8 representative projects. Prioritize corrosion-resistant reinforcement applications while confirming technical and commercial requirements.
emailNote: An editable email draft has been downloaded. Nothing has been sent.
reportEmptyBody: Generate a Chinese, English or bilingual briefing with opportunities, product matches, risks and recommended actions.
noResultsBody: Try another keyword or reset your filters.
savedSubtitle: A focused shortlist for follow-up and team review.
savedEmptyBody: Use the bookmark beside an opportunity to add it to your shortlist.
competitorSubtitle: Monitor domestic FRP manufacturers and signals relevant to the China market.
insightsSubtitle: Understand where opportunity is concentrated across provinces and applications.
settingsSubtitle: A China-first foundation, ready to grow with your business.
architectureBody: Market configuration, localized content and product data are separated. Additional countries and languages can be registered in later phases. Only China is enabled in this prototype.
dataSourcesBody: Mock data only. No scraping, live tender monitoring or external AI service is connected.
tenderSubtitle: Review requirements, product fit and information gaps before your team makes a decision.
reviewNote: Review acknowledges this mock analysis; it does not approve engineering, pricing or bidding.
reportScope: Detailed register: 8 mock projects. Dashboard totals represent an illustrative wider market snapshot.
